bandos.name: Chiari e Forti
bandos.about: The old Chiari e Forti oil factory on the Sile river: brick blocks with broken roofs, roofless galleries by the river, the water tower and the "cuore" lantern tower.

bandos.name: Bando Villetta
bandos.about: The famous main store: four barrel-vault halls with the store shell and columns inside, its annex and old greenhouse frame, concrete aprons, in the fields near Treviso.
